column2: Traditionally an area of conflict between our Rhonnst brothers and Sioux and Angolquin tribes, the Tjorin region is now being threatened by Vinlander expansionism. We must move quickly if we are to secure our borders against western agression.

Although sparsely populated, the Torsmark region is home to a significant Rhonnst population. We should establish firmer control of the area in hopes of deterring further western expansionism and exploitation of our kin.
